scope: Independent reconstruction of the released SH0ES-2022 linear Gaussian ladder, before inspecting new fitted outcomes; not an independent remeasurement of upstream photometry or a Gaussian H0 prior for existing cosmology fits.
model: Released y=L^T q+noise with released full C, no added diagonal errors, covariance rescaling, extra anchor priors, or selection changes. Verify parameter/row semantics against author code and Riess2022 equation6/appendix.
solve: Cholesky whiten C; solve whitened design by QR/SVD. Independently compare normal-equation Cholesky solution, covariance, residual orthogonality and chi-square. Rank deficiency must remain explicit: only exactly zero design columns may be fixed at author's stated nominal values, otherwise fail before H0 reporting.
uncertainty: Gaussian likelihood covariance in native linear parameters with locally flat parameter measure; transform published 5log10(H0) coordinate exactly to lognormal summaries and equal-tail intervals, and report linear error propagation for the author's comparison. Do not apply author broad MCMC boxes as new informative data.
comparison: Compare every native fitted coefficient/uncertainty against rounded author least-square values; separately compare transformed H0 against the published baseline and distinguish matrix statistical uncertainty from analysis-variant systematic budget.
diagnostics: Conditional residual goodness-of-fit with N-rank degrees of freedom; selected anchor omission/sensitivity only if row identity is established before fitting; no automatic clipping or outcome-based covariance tuning.
overlap: Map released SN identifiers and available coordinates/redshifts against current Dovekie registry; preserve ambiguous aliases and repeat light-curve rows. An event overlap inventory is not the absent cross-release systematic covariance.
integration: No multiplication of released H0 likelihood with current Dovekie, Pantheon or shared calibrator products. Identify exact available covariance blocks and missing transformed cross-release terms; Cepheid-only/anchor extraction requires explicit row mapping and removal of reused SN information.
resources: One BLAS/OMP thread; bounded FITS and paper release downloads; no cosmological chains or full CMB calculations.
